crossRefs.note: All the multitude sought to touch him, for power came out of him and healed them all.
But you are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God’s own possession, that you may proclaim…

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: But Jesus said, “Someone did touch me, for I perceived that power has gone out of me.”
translations.bsb: But Jesus declared, “Someone touched Me, for I know that power has gone out from Me.”
translations.kjv: And Jesus said, Somebody hath touched me: for I perceive that virtue is gone out of me.
translations.asv: But Jesus said, Some one did touch me; for I perceived that power had gone forth from me.
